actor: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL)
summary: CNIL's restricted committee imposed the then-maximum GDPR fine of €20m on Clearview AI for unlawful biometric processing, failure to honour access/erasure rights and non-cooperation, ordered it to stop collecting French residents' data and delete what it held within two months, under a €100,000/day penalty. Announced 20 October 2022.
notes: Fine announced 20 October 2022; €100,000/day penalty for non-compliance.

summary: The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens fined the Minister of Finance/Tax Administration €3.7m for the Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV), a blacklist holding fraud signals on over 270,000 people (2013–2020) with no legal basis, inaccurate/outdated data, excessive retention and inadequate security. Decision 7 April 2022, published 12 April 2022.
source_title: European Data Protection Board, national news, 12 Apr 2022
notes: Decision of 7 April 2022, published 12 April 2022. No single incident row: the FSV blacklist ran 2013–2020 and no verified incident date was established.

actor: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali
summary: The Garante imposed an urgent temporary limitation on Luka Inc.'s processing of Italian users' data via the Replika AI companion chatbot, finding concrete risks to minors (sexually inappropriate replies, no age verification) and no valid legal basis for processing children's data.
source_title: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, press room
notes: Urgent temporary limitation on Luka Inc.'s processing of Italian users' data via Replika.

actor: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali
summary: The Garante ordered an immediate temporary limitation on OpenAI's processing of Italians' personal data via ChatGPT (provision of 30 March 2023, announced 31 March), citing no legal basis for mass training-data collection, no user information, inaccurate outputs and no age verification; the limitation was lifted on 12 April 2023 subject to measures, and service resumed 28 April 2023.
source_title: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, press room
notes: Provision of 30 March 2023, announced 31 March; limitation lifted 12 April 2023 subject to measures, service resumed 28 April 2023.

summary: The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens imposed a €30.5m fine on Clearview AI (decision 16 May 2024, announced 3 September 2024) for its illegal facial-recognition database of 30bn+ photos including Dutch citizens, plus an order subject to a penalty of up to €5.1m for continued non-compliance; it is also examining personal liability of directors.
notes: Decision of 16 May 2024, announced 3 September 2024. Not linked to FR-I-01: that incident is the French CNIL finding; the Dutch fine concerns Clearview's database including Dutch citizens.

summary: Report of the EDPB ChatGPT Taskforce (established 13 April 2023) setting out preliminary views on lawfulness, fairness, accuracy, transparency and data-subject rights for ChatGPT, including that web-scraped training data poses fundamental-rights risks and that compliance responsibility cannot be transferred to data subjects.
source_title: European Data Protection Board, ChatGPT Taskforce report

summary: The DPC concluded High Court proceedings (brought 8 August 2024 under s.134 Data Protection Act 2018) after X agreed permanently to adhere to its undertaking on processing EU/EEA users' public posts to train Grok; the DPC had warned of risks to fundamental rights, and simultaneously asked the EDPB for the Art. 64(2) opinion that became Opinion 28/2024.
notes: High Court proceedings brought 8 August 2024 under s.134 Data Protection Act 2018. Not linked to EU-I-01: these proceedings concerned Grok training, not the 2026 deepfakes.

actor: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali
summary: The Garante ordered an urgent, immediate limitation on Hangzhou and Beijing DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence's processing of Italian users' data and opened an investigation, after the companies' reply to its 28 January information request was judged "completely insufficient" and they claimed EU law did not apply to them; the order also cited storage of data in China without GDPR safeguards.
source_title: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, press room
notes: Urgent limitation on Hangzhou and Beijing DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence; investigation opened.

summary: The Commission opened new formal DSA proceedings against X and extended its December 2023 proceedings, to assess whether X diligently assessed and mitigated systemic risks from deploying Grok into X (including illegal content, gender-based violence and harm to physical/mental well-being) and filed the required ad hoc risk assessment; suspected infringements of DSA Arts. 34, 35 and 42.
notes: Formal DSA proceedings opened; suspected infringements of DSA Arts. 34, 35 and 42. Binding 'no': proceedings are an investigation, not a final decision.
